static_traits.name: Lu Kai
static_traits.family_status: Wife was recently laid off; has a son on the local football team
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, but has not yet shared the current conflict with them; other social details not mentioned
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy; no history of similar problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly coherent logic, good cooperation; neutral tone but significant anxiety; thinking often shows 'jumping to conclusions' (mind reading, predicting the future) and catastrophizing tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: Since my wife was recently laid off, I feel torn about whether to pursue my dream of founding a gaming-industry startup, worrying that doing so during financially uncertain times will make my wife resent me; this has affected work focus, sleep and couple communication, leaving me in 'decision paralysis' over whether to launch the company.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling to help me navigate this difficult stage between career ambition and family finances; I just want to feel less stuck and more hopeful about the future.

core_beliefs: Pursuing personal dreams will hurt family relationships
Financial uncertainty means failure and danger

special_situations.event: After my wife was laid off, family finances are in an uncertain state
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Starting a business during financially uncertain times is irresponsible and will make my partner resent me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shelves or avoids decisions and actions about entrepreneurship to maintain surface stability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She will hate me; we will be dragged down by financial problems

special_situations.event: When discussing starting a business with the wife, she expresses worry about the risks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My partner expressing concern equals not supporting me and blaming me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Takes a defensive stance, arguing or ending conversations, reducing in-depth communication
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She is blaming me, not supporting my dream

special_situations.event: Thinking of the poor economic situation and the reality of my wife's unemployment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A bad economy will inevitably lead to startup failure and serious financial consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly focuses on worst-case scenarios, persistently worries, and avoids concrete planning
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everything will go wrong; we will fall into a bad financial situation

special_situations.event: Repeatedly thinking about career future and family finances at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot be completely certain of safety and stability right now, I absolutely should not take any step
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Taking 'must be stable before acting' as the principle, choosing not to act to avoid risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I absolutely cannot start a business now

core_conflict.wish: Longs to pursue entrepreneurial dreams with the partner's support, gaining autonomy and achievement
core_conflict.fear: Fearing that one's own choice will trigger a financial crisis and be resented by one's wife, thereby damaging the relationship
defense_goal: Tries to maintain stability and avoid making entrepreneurial decisions to reduce conflict
Repressing inner desires by emphasizing external risks

object_relations.self_representation: A blamed risk-taker, a person who may bring risk to the family
object_relations.object_representation: A risk-worrying critic, a partner unsupportive of the dream

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the risks and feasibility of starting a business with his wife or the counselor, or when the other party raises doubts and emphasizes risks
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding the other's concern as negation of and blame toward one's dream (transference: projecting the fear of being judged and resented onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopt a calm but defensive tone, emphasizing economic data and risks, offering multiple 'now is not the time' reasons, avoiding exploring the emotional experience of being resented by my wife.

manifestations: The conflict between pursuing entrepreneurial freedom and shouldering family responsibility
Fears choices bringing relationship breakdown and financial loss of control
Hesitating over autonomous choices amid uncertainty

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Attributes the inner fear of being resented to 'my wife will hate me'
Interpreting the partner's concern as lack of support or blame
In counseling, uses others' possible negative reactions to decide one's own choices

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Overly cautious, emphasizes needing stability before acting
Frequent self-restriction leading to inaction (decision paralysis)
Excessively focuses on risks and worst scenarios, weakening contact with resources and possibilities

positive_force: Has game industry experience and connections (understands the industry, friends may have investment intentions)
Having some savings as a buffer
Willing to take small probing steps (drafting a business plan and seeking feedback)
Having a few close friends as potential support
negative_force: Tending to jump to conclusions (mind reading and predicting the future), catastrophizing and overgeneralizing
Fear of conflict leading to decision paralysis
When communicating with the wife, highly defensive; arguments increase
External pressure from financial uncertainty and partner unemployment
Disturbed sleep and decreased concentration affecting judgment and work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Decision paralysis (hard to decide about starting a business)
antecedent: Wife's unemployment and uncertain family finances
Thinking about career future and startup risks
Arguments arise when discussing this topic with his wife
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being resented by my wife and financial failure; cognitive distortions (catastrophizing, mind reading, predicting the future) maintaining anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential risks and relationship conflict, maintaining short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Career stagnation, worsened anxiety, persistently tense couple relationship

antecedent: When wife expresses worry or emphasizes risks
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting the partner's concern as lack of support and blame (jumping to conclusions, personalization), self-worth threatened
target_behavior.function: Protecting one's dreams and self-esteem, displacing inner anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension, mutually decreased support, the problem worsening further

antecedent: Persistently worrying about the future and finances
Repeatedly thinking about worst-case scenarios at night
target_behavior.core_reason: High anxiety and rumination causing physiological arousal and disrupted routines
target_behavior.function: Ineffective emotional coping, gaining a false sense of control by staying vigilant
target_behavior.consequence: Physical fitness declines and concentration is impaired, work performance further declines
